correctness.rationale: The PBW monomial product gives the displayed complete commutator matrix. Its rank is four when the linear part is nonzero outside lambda=-1, and a 2-by-2 determinant plus one row-space condition counts all remaining strata. The lambda=-1 and lambda=1 boundaries are separately handled. Each branch sums to q^9. Direct full-matrix enumeration over fields of orders 2, 3, 4, 5 and sampled larger fields matches the formulas, including characteristic two and the primitive-fourth-root rank gap. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the canonical first two-generator cubic quantum complete intersection the complete commuting-centralizer spectrum is natural. The sharp order-four disappearance of rank three, while ranks one, two and four persist, is an arithmetic structural boundary invisible to the center dimension and the previously known fixed order-three formula. The exact all-twist census gives every commuting-pair probability and a nonroutine parameter-phase classification, with known specializations credited.
